```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
      
# Add any other libraries here
```

```{r load-data}
# load your data 
bike_data <- read_csv("data/SeoulBikeData.csv")
glimpse(bike_data)
bike_data <- bike_data %>%
  clean_names()
names(bike_data)

bike_data <- bike_data %>%
  rename(
    temperature = temperature_yin,
    dew_point_temperature = dew_point_temperature_yin
  )

names(bike_data)
sum(is.na(bike_data))
nrow(bike_data)
nrow(distinct(bike_data))
bike_clean <- bike_data %>%
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")

glimpse(bike_clean)

nrow(bike_clean)
bike_clean %>%
  distinct(date, hour) %>%
  nrow()


```


#Research Question1: How does bike rental demand vary across different hours of the day and seasons?
hourly_rentals <- bike_clean %>%
  group_by(hour) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count)
  )
ggplot(hourly_rentals, aes(x = hour, y = avg_rentals)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bike Rentals by Hour",
    x = "Hour of the Day",
    y = "Average Number of Bike Rentals"
  )
  
  seasonal_avg <- bike_clean %>%
  group_by(seasons) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count)
  )
  ggplot(seasonal_avg,
       aes(x = seasons, y = avg_rentals, fill = seasons)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Bike Rentals by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Average Number of Bike Rentals"
  )
  
  seasonal_rentals <- bike_clean %>%
  group_by(seasons, hour) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count)
  )
ggplot(seasonal_rentals,
       aes(x = hour, y = avg_rentals, colour = seasons)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Hourly Bike Rentals by Season",
    x = "Hour of the Day",
    y = "Average Number of Bike Rentals"
  )
  
  
#Research Question2 : How do weather conditions affect bike rental demand in Seoul?

ggplot(bike_clean,
       aes(x = temperature,
           y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_smooth() +
  labs(
    title = "Bike Rentals vs Temperature",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Number of Bike Rentals"
  )
  
ggplot(bike_clean,
       aes(x = temperature,
           y = rented_bike_count)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bike Rentals vs Temperature",
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Number of Bike Rentals"
  )
